name: sdlckit
description: Claude Code, engineered. An opinionated SDLC workflow for Claude Code.

plugins.name: sdlckit-workflow
plugins.description: The core engineering workflow: plan with the right specialists, implement, prove it with the project's real gates, review the diff, fix, and reach PR-readiness.

plugins.name: sdlckit-backend
plugins.description: Backend experts and rulebooks for NestJS, PostgreSQL and Supabase. They review changes only in repos where those domains are present.

plugins.name: sdlckit-frontend
plugins.description: Frontend experts and rulebooks for React, React Native and Vite, plus ui-craft, the UI quality standard for Tailwind, shadcn and NativeWind.

plugins.name: sdlckit-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure experts and rulebooks for AWS, Terraform and AI agent systems. Dormant in repos without those domains; never applies or deploys anything.

plugins.name: sdlckit-team
plugins.description: The delivery team: a PO interviews you, architect, tech lead and staff engineer plan, a designer specs the UI, engineers build in worktrees, QA verifies with evidence, and you approve at three gates.
